item.description: Harper says its single-runtime architecture, which keeps app code and data together, is up to 14x faster than a Vercel-based stack for real-time personalized workloads. The benchmark used the same UI and data to build the app twice: Harper won on real-time data paths, while Vercel won on cacheable content and high-concurrency fan-out. item.title: [infoq] Flux 推出 Mirror 插件：只让可信制品进入 Kubernetes 集群
item.description: Flux Mirror is a new CLI plugin from Flux that declaratively mirrors container images, Helm charts, and OCI artifacts between registries. It enforces Cosign signatures and a minimum age policy, so only trusted artifacts can reach Kubernetes clusters. The plugin also addresses risks like Docker Hub rate limits and the Bitnami catalog freeze, making it useful for teams running Gitless GitOps on OCI-based desired state.

item.title: [infoq] Azure DevOps Remote MCP 服务器正式发布，暂不支持 Claude、ChatGPT 及 Cursor
item.description: Microsoft has made Azure DevOps Remote MCP Server generally available, providing a hosted endpoint for AI assistants to reach work items, pull requests, repos, and pipelines without local setup. Authentication uses Entra ID, which currently blocks Claude Desktop, Claude Code, ChatGPT, and Cursor because those clients can't do Entra's dynamic OAuth client registration or client ID metadata documents. Only Microsoft's own clients, like VS Code with GitHub Copilot, work for now.

item.title: [hackernews] MS Paint and Photos inivisibly watermark even locally generated output with GUID

Local generation therefore doesn't guarantee an untraceable file. The finding matters for privacy-conscious users and for anyone researching AI-content provenance, though only the mechanism has been confirmed so far.
